abstell_mikromob: Parking locations for small vehicles like bikes and scooters.
admin_boundaries: National and regional administrative borders with country codes and names.
berlin_districts: Berlin administrative districts (Bezirke) with official boundaries
berlin_subdivision_population: Population of Berlin's subdivisions, including districts and neighborhoods.
bplan_official_documents: Official urban development plans and their associated legal documents.
detailnetz_connection_points: Connection points for traffic networks, including road and path junctions.
detailnetz_road_segments: Road network segments with street names, classifications, and traffic direction information.
detailnetz_structures: Transport infrastructure structures including bridges, tunnels, and culverts along road networks.
gewerbedaten: Business location points with geographic identifiers for urban planning districts in Berlin.
landmarks: Unified location index of all major landmarks, districts, and named locations in Berlin
osm_allotment_gardens: Polygon features representing allotment gardens, including their names, access rules, and operators.
osm_atm: Automated teller machines and cash points
osm_buildings: Official Berlin buildings dataset from cadastral/municipal sources. Contains 760,088 building footprints with MultiPolygon geometries. Key columns: bezgfk (building use/function in German: Wohnhaus, Schule, etc.), bezbaw (building form: Reihenhaus, Doppelhaushälfte, etc.), nam (building name), use (array of landuse categories: RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, INDUSTRIAL, EDUCATION, HEALTHCARE, RELIGIOUS, CULTURAL, SPORTS, HOSPITALITY, TRANSPORTATION, UTILITIES, AGRICULTURE, FUNERARY, PUBLIC_SAFETY, ADMINISTRATION, PARKING, OTHER). Query examples: 'RESIDENTIAL' = ANY(use) for residential buildings, WHERE 'RESIDENTIAL' = ANY(use) AND 'COMMERCIAL' = ANY(use) for mixed-use. For German queries, use bezgfk ILIKE '%Wohnen%'. Use geometry for spatial operations.
osm_clinics: Outpatient medical clinics and health centers
osm_districts: Geographic boundaries and names of districts from OpenStreetMap.
osm_fire_stations: Fire department stations and emergency services
osm_gyms: Fitness centers, gyms, and sports facilities
osm_hospitals: Medical facilities providing hospital services and emergency care
osm_landuse: Land use areas from OpenStreetMap, including classifications and identifiers.
osm_parking: Parking areas, garages, and parking facilities
osm_parks: Parks, green spaces, and recreational areas
osm_police_stations: Police stations and law enforcement offices
osm_restaurants: Restaurants, cafes, bars, and food establishments
osm_street_lights: Street light locations with operational details and Berlin district information.
osm_transport_stops: Public transportation stops (bus, tram, train stations)
osm_veterinary: Veterinary clinics and animal medical services
osm_water_bodies: Water bodies including lakes, rivers, and ponds
parkplaetze: Parking space locations with capacity, restrictions, fees, and operating hours.
table_metadata: Catalog of geospatial datasets with their names, descriptions, and schemas.

vector.osm_landuse.name: Berlin Land Use Areas (ALKIS INSPIRE)
vector.osm_landuse.description: Existing Land Use (ELU) data from German ALKIS cadastral system for Berlin. Contains polygon boundaries of land use zones with HILUCS classifications (hierarchical INSPIRE land cover/use classification system).

vegetation_ndvi: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) data from Sentinel-2 for vegetation monitoring
wasserschutzgebiete: Water protection zones for waterworks, including legal ordinance details and boundaries.
